name: nextGEMS Cycle 3 ICON simulations
size_as_stated: 5.5 years of global climate simulation at approximately 6.3 km horizontal resolution. Training period covers 11680 time steps (20 Jan 2020 - 19 Jan 2024); test period spans 2920 time steps (20 Jan 2024 - 20 Jan 2025); validation spans 21 Jan 2025 - 20 Jul 2025. 320x320 grid-point patches.

scales.note: nextGEMS cycle 3 global simulation with ICON at ~6.3 km coarsened to 63 km, sampled 3-hourly over 5.5 years.
